title: Romans say Phoenicians sacrificed children to Molech

tellings.quote: their rights, including according to the Romans, they sacrificed their children to Molech.

plain: The Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people whose reach included the island of Sardinia, sacrificed their children to a god called Molech, at least according to Roman accounts. A researcher named Tim Alberino brings this up when describing their rites, citing the Romans without naming any particular text.
